categories.main_business_segments: FUJIMI INCORPORATED operates primarily in the manufacturing and sales of polishing materials. Its main business segments are: Silicon business (polishing materials for silicon wafers), CMP business (chemical mechanical planarization materials for semiconductor devices), Disk business (polishing materials for hard disk substrates), Thermal Spray Materials business (powder materials for surface treatment in various industries), Polishing Solutions business (comprehensive polishing solutions for diverse materials and shapes), and Advanced Technology & Functional Materials (expansion into powder and non-polishing fields).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core technologies are filtration/classification/purification technology (removing coarse particles and impurities), powder technology (controlling particle shape and uniform mixing/granulation), and chemical technology (designing and blending additives for dispersion, dissolution, and surface protection). These underpin the development and production of high-precision polishing materials and functional powders, with a strong focus on process innovation and quality control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include silicon wafer manufacturers, semiconductor device makers, and hard disk substrate producers. Major end markets are the semiconductor industry (including advanced logic and memory devices), electronics, automotive (especially for EV/HEV components), data centers, and general industrial sectors requiring high-precision surface processing.
categories.geographic_coverage: FUJIMI operates globally with production and sales bases in Japan, North America (USA), Asia (Malaysia, Taiwan, China), and Europe (Germany). The company has a particularly strong presence in Japan, the US, Taiwan, and Malaysia, serving customers worldwide.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company is positioned midstream to downstream in the supply chain, supplying advanced materials and solutions directly to manufacturers of semiconductors, electronic components, and industrial products, as well as providing process solutions to end users.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening the core polishing materials business, expanding into new powder and surface-related fields, and reducing dependency on the semiconductor sector by growing non-semiconductor and non-polishing applications. R&D focuses on next-generation semiconductor materials, advanced CMP and polishing technologies, new functional ceramics, and sustainability (e.g., energy efficiency, ESG initiatives). The company is also investing in global supply chain resilience and digital transformation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of polishing materials, functional powders, and related products, as well as comprehensive polishing solutions and, to a lesser extent, licensing (royalties from intellectual property). The business is largely transaction-based, with some recurring sales to major industrial customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: FUJIMI holds the world's top market share in ultra-precision polishing materials for semiconductor substrates and is recognized as a leading company in the field. It faces competition from both domestic and international firms in the advanced materials and CMP sectors, but maintains a strong competitive edge through technological leadership, quality, and customer trust.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In FY2025, consolidated sales reached 62.5 billion yen (approx. $400 million), with operating profit of 11.8 billion yen and net profit attributable to shareholders of 9.4 billion yen. The company has shown robust growth (21.5% YoY sales increase), high profitability (EBITDA margin 22.1%), and maintains a strong balance sheet with high equity ratio (83.7%). Employee count is 1,235, reflecting ongoing business expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: FUJIMI emphasizes its ability to deliver world-class, high-quality, and highly reliable polishing materials and solutions tailored to advanced industry needs. Its differentiation lies in proprietary core technologies, deep customer collaboration, comprehensive process solutions, and a proven track record of supporting cutting-edge semiconductor and industrial manufacturing. The company also highlights its commitment to sustainability, supply chain stability, and continuous innovation.
